<includeonly>{{#invoke:Erenshor/ClassAbilities|abilities}}</includeonly><noinclude>
Lists the spells and skills that obtainable items teach to a class, their required levels, and alternate teaching items. The teaching item's class restrictions apply to spells. Skills also require a positive required level for the class.

Place <code>{{Class abilities}}</code> on a class page, or <code>{{Class abilities|stablekey=class:druid}}</code> to select a class explicitly.
</noinclude>
